channel.title: BRYME — writing opportunities, guides and verification
channel.description: Legitimate paid-writing opportunities, practical guides and BRYME's firsthand verification record.

item.title: The Dark Magazine: 5¢ per word
item.description: The Dark pays 5¢ per word for original horror and dark fantasy up to 6,000 words. Submit by email; no simultaneous or AI-assisted work.

item.title: SmokeLong Quarterly submissions: $100–$150
item.description: SmokeLong publishes flash up to 1,000 words and pays $100, or $150 if you grant audio rights. See reading windows and anonymous-submission rules.

item.title: khōréō submissions: $0.10 per word
item.description: khōréō pays $0.10 per word for speculative fiction by immigrant and diaspora writers. Its next fiction window is November 1–30, 2026.

item.title: The Dublin Review submissions: from €300
item.description: The Dublin Review welcomes unpublished fiction and nonfiction in English, with fees from €300 for pieces up to 2,500 words. Submit online.
